hybrids.desc: Where twilight orchid meets wildwood herb: fronds that smoulder softly without ever burning.
hybrids.name: Emberfern

hybrids.desc: Moss grown up through living crystal; it chimes faintly whenever the moon rises.
hybrids.name: Crystalmoss

hybrids.desc: A quartz bloom holding the exact color of dusk, five minutes after sunset.
hybrids.name: Gloamquartz

hybrids.desc: A fallen star's last spark, coaxed patiently into leaf and stem.
hybrids.name: Starwhisp

hybrids.desc: Elder crystal veined with wildwood shadow; it drinks moonlight and pours it back doubled.
hybrids.name: Moonshade Prism

hybrids.desc: A fern that only unfurls after dark, humming the low songs of the root cellar.
hybrids.name: Nightfern

hybrids.desc: Constellation-thread lace draped over a velvet nocturne bloom; it maps stars no one has named.
hybrids.name: Dusklace

hybrids.desc: The Haven's rarest hybrid: a heart that beats once per century, entirely in light.
hybrids.name: Twilightheart
